title: Artifact version directory v1
description: Canonical success envelope for one explicit historical artifact page. Definitions also describe SDK, CLI and MCP query objects; HTTP query values are decoded and parsed separately.
$comment: Source artifact only, not runtime evidence. Register this complete resource before resolving its anchors. The ID identifies the schema, not a hosted endpoint. The shared parseArtifactVersions* functions remain authoritative for byte limits, UTF-16 lengths, canonical timestamps, exact query/scope/trace binding, cross-field comparisons, descending versions and continuation. No authorization, content availability or upload outcome is established by this schema.

scopeIdentifier.$comment: Scope identifiers are not restricted to ULIDs. Runtime additionally rejects unpaired surrogates and enforces UTF-16 length and equality with the verified request scope.

timestamp.$comment: Format may be annotation-only in a validator. Runtime requires a valid exact ISO UTC millisecond round-trip and updated_at >= created_at.

ArtifactVersionsQuery.title: ArtifactVersionsQuery
ArtifactVersionsQuery.description: One explicit directory read. Input limit may be omitted; runtime normalizes it to ten. Retain the entire next_query for another page.

at_version.description: Inclusive ceiling. Must not exceed the currently visible artifact version.

before_version.description: Exclusive position. Requires at_version and must not exceed that ceiling.

ArtifactVersionsQuery.$comment: The serialized input is limited to 4096 bytes at runtime. default is an annotation, not an instruction to mutate input. Comparing before_version to at_version requires the shared runtime parser.

ArtifactVersionsNormalizedQuery.title: Canonical echoed query
ArtifactVersionsNormalizedQuery.$comment: Every canonical producer returns limit explicitly. The runtime parser can normalize omitted input defaults before comparison.

ArtifactVersionsNextQuery.title: Complete continuation query
ArtifactVersionsNextQuery.$comment: Runtime binds artifact_id and limit to the original query, at_version to snapshot_version and before_version to the last returned version. A real continuation requires a last version greater than one.

ArtifactVersionSummary.title: Historical artifact metadata summary
ArtifactVersionSummary.$comment: Metadata only: no storage key, object bytes, source list, receipt or write ETag. The hash is a saved descriptor; this read does not verify object content.

ArtifactVersionsPage.title: Canonical artifact version page
ArtifactVersionsPage.$comment: Runtime checks items.length <= query.limit (equal when has_more), strictly descending unique versions within the ceiling/exclusive position, complete original-query equality and exact continuation binding. A sparse history is allowed; this is not an audit of all versions or a cross-page database snapshot.

ArtifactVersionsEnvelope.title: Artifact version directory success envelope v1
ArtifactVersionsEnvelope.$comment: Complete serialized success is limited to 262144 bytes. Runtime requires original request trace/scope/target equality, with source_refs[0].id equal to query.artifact_id. No outer revision or ETag. HTTP separately requires 200, JSON, matching x-trace-id and no cache/write conditions.
